title: Outboxes and database-backed jobs
brief: Commit a durable intention with the domain change, then deliver or claim work despite duplicate execution and worker loss. Design deduplication, leases, expiry and fencing so recovery preserves the intended external effects.

neighbouring_ownership.locks: Owns general locking; this article applies claiming mechanisms.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-logical-replication: Owns native row-change streams rather than application outbox semantics.

title: Inside PostgreSQL
brief: Trace one connection and request through PostgreSQL processes, shared buffers, heap tuples and indexes. Explain tuple visibility, HOT updates and their physical limits so native plans and maintenance have a concrete physical setting.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-vacuum: Owns retained horizons and transaction-age maintenance.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-wal: Owns durability controls and crash drills.

title: PostgreSQL physical replicas and promotion
brief: Operate a physical standby with separate receipt, flush and replay evidence. Choose synchronous promises, perform fenced promotion with an explicit loss boundary, and return a former primary safely.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-logical-replication: Owns selective row streams and their separate lifecycle.

title: Upgrading and migrating PostgreSQL
brief: Choose between a major upgrade and a logical migration, then rehearse compatibility, a recoverable write handover and acceptance. Identify the point after which a simple return is no longer possible.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-migration: Owns the PostgreSQL-to-CockroachDB application contract transfer.
